title: PZ Agent Local Core RPC Response
description: One answer to a Core RPC request. `ok` is required and never inferred: a reader that took an absent `error` for success would turn a dropped field into a success, and a reader that took it for failure would invent one with no reason.

id.description: The id of the request this answers.

code.description: MALFORMED, TOO_LARGE and PROTOCOL_MISMATCH mean the message never reached a method. UNKNOWN_METHOD means the router has no such name. CORE_REFUSED carries the core's own refusal. TIMEOUT and UNAVAILABLE are the client's own, never sent by a server.

message.description: Names the field and the reason, never the value. This string reaches a traceback and a bug report before any redactor sees it.
